mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_user (coupon_id, user_id, status, order_id, receive_time, use_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{couponId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{orderId}, #{receiveTime}, #{useTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupon_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY status ASC, create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_user SET status = 1, order_id = #{orderId}, use_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupon_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND coupon_id = #{couponId} LIMIT 1
